LESSON: PANCH- MAHABHOOT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Panch- mahabhoot

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Panch- mahabhoot
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is water important in our life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state water bodies that are considered sacred as mentioned in the Scriptures to strengthen faith
2. identify the role of water in our daily lives
3. appreciate the importance of jal (water) used for religious activities in different faiths for its sacredness
4. name plants that are considered sacred for familiarisation
5. identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for inspiration
6. appreciate the teachings of Enlightened Beings for spiritual and moral growth
7. explain the lessons learnt from the Scriptures for inspiration
8. apply the teachings of the Scriptures for righteous living
